notes.title: Clothing Pack DLC second update!
notes.content:
Dear players,

A brand new clothing pack including the 'Oriental Classics', 'Modern Occupations', and 'Panty Party' are now available! This DLC includes 48 new sets of clothes for 16 of our characters.

In addition to this, with this DLC, the gift shop boss will appear as a woman!

Come any try it out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1048770/Legend_Of_Mercy_EX_clothing_pack_II__II/

notes.title: Clothing Packs now come with additional CGs!
notes.content:
Hello players, we have added some special CGs to some of the Clothing Packs! 

These are now included with the “Old World, Modern Style”, and “Day at the Beach” packs. They show off some beautiful times with the girls. If you have these DLCs, you can view the new pieces of wonderful art in the Gallery.

Thank you for your support! We hope you enjoy Legend of Mercy!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32562680/a2b7b467a7ba26d4d4a849406dbbd1c4ad632250.png[/img]

notes.title: Clothing Packs Updated!
notes.content:
In this new update, we have added a number of new characters to the Clothing Packs. 

One of these new clothing sets is for the Gift Shop owner, but we haven’t stopped there… we even have a costume for the cat! 

If you have the clothing DLCs active, go to the Gift Shop to check out his new outfit!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32562680/f4f0c83209720765dec8e01201e6cec9e34a4be7.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Clothing Expansion Pack DLC Now Released!
notes.content:
Hello players, our next clothing DLC is now released!

It includes the clothing packs “Advanced Fantasy”, “Old World, Modern Style”, and “Day at the Beach”! In total, it includes 48 new clothing sets for 16 characters in the game. 

Steam Page: 
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1019110]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1019110[/url]

notes.title: Clothing Swap System Now Live!
notes.content:
A new special mode in the Extras menu (Extras -> DLC -> Additional content  -> Clothing) is now unlocked! With this, the girls can now be seen wearing new and more beautiful outfits in their spare time.
The first clothing set, with the theme of seasonal Christmas clothing, is free. Later, we'll have more clothing sets available as DLC.

Thank you everyone for supporting Legend of Mercy and we wish you a merciful Christmas!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32562680/77648201e7179b1f1b8427e49f01ed4b6daede07.jpg[/img]

notes.title: English Version Released!
notes.content:
Hello players,

We are happy to announce that the English Version Language Patch has been officially released. We welcome all of you to play through the game in English!
When you launch the game, the language should be automatically set to English, but you can also manually choose your language in the Steam properties for the game.
One important thing to note is that the Chinese and English save files are not compatible with each other. If you played the Chinese version originally, you cannot continue your progress in the English version and vice-versa.
Legend of Mercy is our first game to be translated into English and because of our lack of experience, we took longer than expected to finish. If you find any bugs, please report them and we will try to fix them as soon as possible.
A very big thank you to the hard work of the translation team Sienna Plus Translations!

And finally, thank you to all the players who have been supporting us and waiting for the English version to be released. We hope everyone can have an exciting adventure in Legend of Mercy!

notes.title: Hello English players!
notes.content:
We are very happy to inform you that the translation of Legend of Mercy is going well.

It is currently over 50% complete and should be completely finished in about a month.

Thank you all for your support! We are looking forward to you being able to play the game in English as soon as possible!

notes.title: English Translation Announcement
notes.content:
Hello players,

Thank you for the support of all the English players who requested we translate our game.

The English translation of Legend of Mercy has officially started, and the whole project is expected to take about 2-3 months to complete.

We may release more information as we continue to translate more of the game. Please stay tuned!

notes.title: 版本更新1.6.5，原声音乐集上线！
notes.content:
[b]原声音乐集DLC与全新标题界面上线！[/b]

原声音乐集DLC首周40%off仅售7元，从游戏里也可以直接打开喔！

另外我们让标题界面的济世者滚蛋了，取而代之是人气最高的女主角安缇诺雅小姐姐。全新的标题界面是动态的哦！

欢迎页面加入了一些新的功能，最新的DLC提醒、直接点击就可以跳转的QQ微博社交媒体按钮以及周边商店。

在标题页面的“特别模式”中，我们取消了需要通关一次才能查看DLC的限制，DLC内容也进行了分类整理方便查阅。
具体情况还请大家自行前往体验一番吧！

祝大家游戏愉快！
